intro_zh_hans: 1943 年，盟军攻占突尼斯市，标志着整个北非由盟军掌控。
intro_en: The capture of Tunis City in 1943 saw all of North Africa in Allied hands.
history_zh_hans: 突尼斯市（突尼斯首都）是盟军 1942 年登陆北非的“火炬行动”的目标之一。突尼斯战役从 1942 年 11 月 17 日持续至 1943 年 5 月 13 日，期间轴心国与同盟国在法属突尼斯爆发了一系列战役，同盟国方的英国、希腊、美国和法国军队联合起来对抗轴心国方的德国和意大利军队。这场战役以同盟国军队的胜利而告终，轴心国军队最后被逐出了北非。
history_en: Tunis City, the capital of Tunisia was one of the Allied objectives in Operation Torch, the Allied landings in North Africa in 1942. The Tunisian Campaign lasted from November 17, 1942 to May 13, 1943 and was a series of battles that took place in French Tunisia between the Axis and the Allies. The Allied coalition consisted of British, Greek, American and French forces versus the German and Italian forces on the Axis side. The campaign ended with an Allied victory and the ejection of the Axis forces from North Africa.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 1943 年 5 月 8 日，一辆丘吉尔坦克正与其他载具穿行于突尼斯市。

intro_zh_hans: 阿莱曼是德国非洲军团在埃及曾到过的最远位置。
intro_en: El Alamein was the furthest the Afrikakorps got in Egypt.
history_zh_hans: 阿莱曼（阿拉伯语：两面旗帜）是坐落在埃及北部的一个小镇。在二战的西部沙漠战役中，隆美尔指挥轴心国军队与盟军在这里进行了两次大战。第一次阿莱曼战役（1942 年 7 月 1 日至 27 日）以僵局告终，但盟军设法阻止了轴心国在亚历山大港的推进。在第二次阿莱曼战役（1942 年 10 月 23 日至 11 月 11 日）中，盟军获得了决定性的胜利，打破了轴心国对北非的控制。
history_en: El Alamein (Arabic: The two flags) is a town in the North of Egypt where two major WWII battles were fought between the Axis, under the command of Rommel, and the Allied forces in the Western Desert Campaign. The First Battle of El Alamein (1–27 July 1942) ended in a stalemate, but the Allies managed to halt the Axis advance on Alexandria. The Second Battle of El Alamein (23 October – 11 November 1942) ended in a decisive Allied victory and broke the grip the Axis had on North Africa.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 埃尔温 · 隆美尔及其副官，埃及沙漠，1942 年 6 月抵达阿莱曼前不久。

intro_en: Moscow is the capital of the Soviet Union.
history_zh_hans: 莫斯科战役是 1941 年 10 月 2 日到 1942 年 1 月 7 日在苏联首都周围地区发生的一场军事战役。莫斯科是轴心国的主要军事目标之一，但苏联红军成功阻止了轴心国的进攻，并发动战略反攻击退了轴心国军队。莫斯科战役被认为是苏联和轴心国之间最重要的战役之一，轴心国的进攻首次被苏联红军阻止。
history_en: The Battle of Moscow was a military campaign that took place during WWII, from October 2, 1941 to January 7, 1942, in the region surrounding the capital of Soviet Union. Moscow was one the primary military objectives of the Axis, but the Red Army managed to halt their offensive and execute a successful strategic counteroffensive that pushed back the Axis forces. The Battle of Moscow is considered to be one of the most important battles fought between Soviet Union and the Axis as it was the first time the Axis advance was stopped by the Red Army.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 高尔基公园里的重型防空火炮及其组员，莫斯科，1941 年。

intro_zh_hans: 瓜达尔卡纳尔岛是所罗门群岛中的一个岛屿，1943 年被美国占领。
intro_en: Guadalcanal is an island in the Solomon Islands, captured by the US in 1943.
history_zh_hans: 瓜达尔卡纳尔岛是所罗门群岛中的一个岛屿，二战时日本和美国曾在这里展开过军事战争。瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役从 1942 年 8 月 7 日开始，一直持续至 1943 年 2 月 9 日，是盟军对日军发起的第一次大规模陆地进攻，也是盟军在太平洋地区取得的第一次决定性胜利。亨德森机场空军基地使该岛成为了战略要地，它帮助盟军控制了澳大利亚和美国之间的海上交通线。
history_en: Guadalcanal is an island in the Solomon Islands where a military campaign in WWII was fought between Japan and the United States. The Guadalcanal Campaign lasted from August 7, 1942 to February 9, 1943, and was the first Allied major land offensive against Japan and the first decisive victory won by the Allies in the Pacific.  What made the island a strategic place of importance was the Henderson Field air base which helped the Allies to control the sea lines of communications between Australia and the United States.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 美国第 164 步兵团的海军陆战队员在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛上休息，1942 年。

intro_zh_hans: 马尼拉是菲律宾的首都，1942 年被日本占领。
intro_en: Manila is the capital of the Philippines, captured by Japan in 1942.
history_zh_hans: 马尼拉是菲律宾的首都，1942 年 1 月被日本帝国军占领。尽管失去了首都，美菲联军仍然继续抵抗，直到 1942 年 5 月科雷吉多岛战役爆发为止。这场决定性的战役以科雷吉多岛命名，美菲联军在一座老旧的西班牙堡垒中为保卫马尼拉湾奋战至最后一刻。科雷吉多岛沦陷后不久，位于菲律宾的盟军指挥官在日军的审查下，通过无线电宣布投降。菲律宾战役（1941 年 12 月至 1942 年 5 月）被认为是美国最严重的军事失败之一，也标志着日本占领菲律宾的开始，总共持续了 3 年，直到 1945 年被盟军重新夺回为止。
history_en: Manila, the capital of the Philippines, was captured by the Imperial Japanese forces in January 1942. Despite having lost the capital, the US-Filipino forces continued to resist up until The Battle of Corregidor that took place in May 1942. The decisive battle is named after Corregidor Island where the US-Filipino forces made a last attempt to defend the Bay of Manila in an old Spanish fortress. Shortly after the fall of Corregidor the Commander of Allied forces in the Philippines announced their surrender over the radio under Japanese censor. The Philippines Campaign, (December 1941 - May 1942) is considered one of the worst military defeats of the US and marked the beginning of the Japanese occupation of the Philippines, which lasted over 3 years, or until it was recaptured by the Allies in 1945.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 日本军队阅兵式，马尼拉，1942 年。

intro_zh_hans: 大英帝国的首都，也是英国和盟国在欧洲的战时行政中心。
intro_en: The capital of the British Empire and the center of the British and Allied war effort in Europe.
history_zh_hans: 1940 年 9 月至 1941 年 5 月，英国首都伦敦曾在“大轰炸”期间遭受德国的强烈袭击。1944 年至 1945 年，德国最新研制的 V1 和 V2 飞弹再次对伦敦造成了大量伤亡和破坏。战争期间，伦敦也是多个流亡政府的所在地，接纳了大量的海外人员，这使它成为了欧洲盟军的战时行政中心。
history_en: London, the capital city of the UK, was hit hard by German bombing in the so called “Blitz” that lasted from September 1940 to May 1941, and from 1944 to 1945 the V1 bomb and V2 rocket attacks caused massive casualties and damage. During the war London was also the home of several governments in exile and hosted large numbers of overseas personnel, which put it at the center of the Allied war effort in Europe.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 德国对伦敦进行轰炸，伦敦大轰炸期间，1940 年。

intro_zh_hans: 华盛顿特区在美国规划和准备二战的过程中发挥了重要作用。
intro_en: Washington DC played a vital role in the United States planning and preparation for WWII.
history_zh_hans: 华盛顿特区，美国的首都，在二战期间经历了巨大的转变。随着政府在战争期间的扩展，城市的人口几乎翻了一番，城市周围新建了数百个政府设施。由于男性都被派往欧洲和太平洋地区作战，新的政府工作人员大部分是女性。华盛顿在战争期间从未受到攻击，也从未面临风险，但为了安全起见，军方确实在城里架设了一些防空炮。
history_en: Washington DC, the capital of the US, went through a drastic transformation during WWII. As the government grew during the war the population of the city nearly doubled and hundreds of new government facilities were built around the city. The majority of the new government workforce were women as the men were sent off to combat in Europe and the Pacific. Washington was never attacked during the war, and was never at risk, but the military did put up some anti-aircraft guns in the city just to be safe.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 政府出版局屋顶上的一门 40 毫米高射炮及炮组人员，华盛顿特区，1944 年。

intro_zh_hans: 布良斯克是反抗德国侵略者的游击队活动中心。
intro_en: Bryansk was the center of partisan activity against the German invaders.
history_zh_hans: 布良斯克市于 1941 年被德国人占领，但在占领期间，有超过 60,000 名游击队员在该市及其周边地区活动，主要来自布良斯基森林。游击队通过炸毁铁路和桥梁以及在战斗中击杀德国士兵，设法破坏德国的补给线。这座城市最终于 1943 年 9 月 17 日被红军解放。
history_en: The city of Bryansk was captured by the Germans in 1941 but during the occupation over 60,000 partisans operated in the region in and around the city, mainly from the Bryanskie Forests. The partisans managed to disrupt the German supply lines by blowing up railways and bridges as well as killing numerous German soldiers in combat. The city was finally liberated by the Red Army on 17 September in 1943.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 布良斯克森林中的苏联游击队，1943 年。

intro_zh_hans: 德军曾在战争期间利用多山的阿登地区发动数次进攻。
intro_en: The Germans used the hilly Ardennes to launch several offensives during the war.
history_zh_hans: 阿登地区，又称阿登森林，其地势崎岖，丘陵和森林广阔。阿登地区位于比利时东南部，延伸到卢森堡、德国和法国，几个世纪以来一直都是欧洲战场上的兵家必争之地。德国在 20 世纪利用该地区发动了三次大型战役，一次是一战期间的阿登战役（1914 年），还有两次在二战期间，即法国战役（1940 年）和突出部之役（1944-1945 年）。
history_en: The Ardennes, also known as the Forest of Ardennes or the Ardennes Forest, is a region of rough terrain, hills and extensive forest. Ardennes is a region in southeast Belgium and extends into Luxembourg, Germany and France, and its strategic position has made it a European battleground for centuries. The Germans have used the region to stage three major battles in the 20th century, in WWI it was the Battle of the Ardennes (1914), and twice during WWII, the Battle of France (1940) and the Battle of the Bulge (1944–1945).
photo_caption_zh_hans: 德国军队在阿登森林行军，1940 年。

intro_zh_hans: 仰光，英国殖民地缅甸的首都，于 1942 年 3 月被日本占领。
intro_en: Rangoon, capital of the British colony of Burma, was captured by Japan in March 1942.
history_zh_hans: 仰光，原称大光，是仰光省的首府，是缅甸（Burma 或 Myanmar）最大的城市。从 1885 年到 1948 年，缅甸一直处于英国的统治之下。在二战期间，缅甸成为轴心国和同盟国间的一个主要战场。日本与缅甸独立军联合，于 1942 年控制了缅甸并一直执政。直到 1944 年，盟军发动了一系列攻势。经过激烈的战斗之后，他们成功结束了日本的占领。许多缅甸人加入了盟军，与英属缅甸军队并肩作战。随着战争的进展，许多最初帮助日本作战的势力都转而加入了盟军。
history_en: Rangoon, also known as Yangon, is the capital of the Yangon region and the largest city of Burma (also known as Myanmar). Burma was under British rule from from 1885 to 1948, but during WWII it became a major battleground between the Axis and Allied powers. Japan, in coalition with the Burma Independence Army, took control of Burma in 1942 and stayed in power until the Allied forces launched a series of offensives in 1944, and after intense fighting they managed to end the Japanese occupation. Many Burmese fought on the Allied side with the British Burma Army, and many that initially fought on the side of Japan switched allegiance to the Allied side as the war progressed.

intro_zh_hans: 1942 年阿拉姆哈勒法战役中，英国军队阻止了轴心国的一次重大进攻。
intro_en: During the Battle of Alam el Halfa in 1942 the British forces halted a major Axis assault.
history_zh_hans: 阿拉姆哈勒法战役发生于 1942 年 8 月 30 日至 9 月 5 日埃及阿拉曼附近。埃尔温 · 隆美尔将军率领的德意军队试图突破英国防线，夺取苏伊士运河。然而，伯纳德 · 蒙哥马利将军预料到了这次攻击，并在高地建立了强大的防御阵地。尽管战斗激烈，但英国军队坚守阵地，迫使隆美尔撤退。这场战役是北非战役的转折点，是轴心国军队最后一次在该地区发动的大规模进攻。
history_en: The Battle of Alam el Halfa took place from August 30th to September 5th, 1942, near El Alamein in Egypt. German and Italian forces, led by General Erwin Rommel, attempted to break through British defenses to seize the Suez Canal. However, the British, under General Bernard Montgomery, anticipated the attack and established strong defensive positions on higher ground. Despite intense fighting, the British forces held their lines, forcing Rommel to retreat. This battle marked a turning point in the North African Campaign, as it was the last major offensive by Axis forces in the region.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 在希迈马特山附近的西部沙漠中巡逻的一辆英国 M3 斯图亚特甜心坦克，埃及，1942 年。

intro_zh_hans: 阿拉库尔战役是 1944 年美军和德军之间的一场坦克战。
intro_en: The Battle of Arracourt was a 1944 tank battle between US and German forces.
history_zh_hans: 阿拉库尔战役（1944 年 9 月 18 日至 29 日）是二战期间美军与德军在法国洛林地区展开的一场关键坦克战。尽管能见度低且兵力不足，美国第 4 装甲师仍凭借其卓越的战术、联合行动以及空中支援，成功挫败了德国第五装甲集团军阻止盟军在法国推进的企图。美军摧毁了 200 多辆德国坦克和突击炮，自己只损失了约 55 辆，取得了决定性的胜利，进一步推动了盟军向德国的推进。
history_en: The Battle of Arracourt (September 18-29, 1944) was a key WWII tank battle in theLorraine region in France between US and German forces. The American 4th Armored Division, despite facing poor visibility and being outnumbered, used superior tactics, combined arms, and air support to counter the German Fifth Panzer Army’s attempt to halt the Allied advance in France. The Americans destroyed over 200 German tanks and assault guns while losing only about 55 of their own, marking a decisive victory that furthered the Allies' push toward Germany.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 阿拉库尔战役后，几辆被击毁谢尔曼坦克和豹式坦克，法国，1944 年。

intro_zh_hans: 1945 年的碧瑶战役涉及日军与盟军。
intro_en: The Battle of Baguio in 1945 involved Japanese and Allied forces.
history_zh_hans: 碧瑶战役发生于 1945 年 3 月至 4 月，是二战期间菲律宾战役的一部分。日军由山下奉文将军率领，在碧瑶的山地地形上构筑防御工事，做最后的防守。美军和菲律宾军，包括第 33 步兵师和当地游击队，面临着日军的强烈抵抗，使用炮火和空袭突破坚固的阵地。尽管地形艰险且敌军防守顽强，盟军仍稳步前进，逐步攻占关键据点，迫使日军后撤。到了 1945 年 4 月底，碧瑶已被盟军控制，标志着菲律宾战役中的一场重要胜利。
history_en: The Battle of Baguio took place from March to April 1945 as part of the Philippines Campaign during WWII. Japanese forces, led by General Tomoyuki Yamashita, fortified Baguio’s mountainous terrain to make a final defensive stand. US and Filipino forces, including the 33rd Infantry Division and local guerrilla fighters, pushed through intense Japanese resistance, using artillery and air strikes to break through the entrenched positions. Despite challenging terrain and a determined Japanese defense, Allied forces advanced steadily, capturing key positions and driving the Japanese back. By late April 1945, Baguio was under Allied control, marking a significant victory in the Philippines Campaign.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 日本九五式轻战车 Ha-Go 和其乘员，菲律宾。

intro_zh_hans: 库尔斯克战役是历史上规模最大的坦克战。
intro_en: The Battle of Kursk was history's largest tank battle.
history_zh_hans: 库尔斯克战役发生于 1943 年 7 月 5 日至 8 月 23 日，是二战期间规模最大的坦克战之一，也是东线的一场关键对决。苏联在斯大林格勒战役中获胜后，德国发起堡垒行动，试图围歼库尔斯克突出部的苏军。然而，苏军稳固防御，有效抵御了德国的进攻。双方伤亡惨重，最终苏军取得胜利，这场战役标志着战争的转折点。苏联终止了德军的进攻势头，获得了主动权，并发起了一系列反攻，将德军逐步击退。
history_en: The Battle of Kursk, fought from July 5th to August 23rd, 1943, was WWII's largest tank battle and a crucial confrontation on the Eastern Front. Following the Soviet victory at Stalingrad, the Germans launched Operation Citadel to encircle Soviet forces in the Kursk salient. However, the Soviets had fortified their defenses, effectively countering the German attacks. The battle resulted in heavy losses on both sides, but the Soviets emerged victorious, marking a turning point in the war. This defeat halted the German advance and allowed the Soviets to gain the initiative, leading to a series of offensives that pushed the Germans back.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 库尔斯克战役期间前进的苏联步兵和坦克，1943 年。

intro_zh_hans: 维莱博卡日战役是 1944 年德国和英国军队之间的一场坦克战。
intro_en: The Battle of Villers-Bocage was a 1944 tank battle between German and British forces.
history_zh_hans: 维莱博卡日战役是卡昂战役的一部分，发生于 1944 年 6 月 13 日，诺曼底登陆后不久。这场激烈的坦克战涉及英德两军，德国指挥官米歇尔 · 魏特曼指挥虎式坦克对英国装甲部队进行了反击。魏特曼伏击英国军队，摧毁多辆坦克，取得了初期胜利。双方伤亡惨重，英军随后撤退，德军短暂控制了该镇。
history_en: The Battle of Villers-Bocage occurred on June 13th, 1944, shortly after the D-Day landings in Normandy, and was part of the larger Battle for Caen. This intense tank battle involved British and German forces, with German commander Michael Wittmann leading a counterattack using Tiger tanks against British armored units. Wittmann achieved early success by ambushing British forces and destroying several tanks. The battle resulted in heavy casualties on both sides and in the retreat of the British forces. This allowed the Germans to take control of the town for a brief period.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 停在卡昂古道（Ancienne Route de Caen）的一辆伪装的虎式坦克，魏特曼的连曾于 1944 年 6 月 12 日至 13 日夜间在此处驻扎。

intro_zh_hans: 小型舰队由一小群共同作战的海军舰艇组成。
intro_en: A flotilla is a small group of naval vessels operating together.
history_zh_hans: 小型舰队（Flotillas）指的是由鱼雷艇、潜艇和巡逻艇等小型舰艇组成的紧凑型海军编队。二战期间，所有大型海军都编组了这种编队，在大型舰艇无法有效行动的沿海、水道和狭窄海域执行任务。德国海军曾部署 S 艇（Schnellboot）和 U 型潜艇舰队。S 艇类似盟军所称的 E 艇（E-boats），部署在英吉利海峡和北海执行夜间突袭任务；而 U 艇舰队则从大西洋港口出发，对盟军航运发起长期袭击。而英国皇家海军则以机动鱼雷艇舰队和护航队进行反制，保卫船队航线，打击轴心国的沿岸运输。美国海军曾在太平洋部署鱼雷艇舰队，扰乱日军驳船运输、侦察登陆海滩，并在所罗门群岛和菲律宾群岛等岛链伏击补给船队。在内陆水域，美国河流舰队以浅吃水炮艇和登陆艇支援缅甸和中国的两栖作战。苏联也在伏尔加河和多瑙河上部署了舰队编队，用于支援地面攻势；而意大利的 MAS 鱼雷快艇与日本的快速突击艇也曾挑战盟军对狭窄海域的控制。尽管体型较小，但舰队编队能够在局部战役中发挥决定性作用，甚至影响到更广泛的战略进程。
history_en: Flotillas are compact naval formations composed of smaller vessels such as torpedo boats, submarines, and patrol craft. During WWII, all major navies organized flotillas to perform missions in coastal zones, rivers, and confined seas where larger ships could not operate effectively. The Kriegsmarine fielded both Schnellboot (e. fast boat) and U-boat flotillas. Schnellboote, named E-boats by the Allies, launched night raids in the Channel and North Sea, while U-boat flotillas, operating from Atlantic ports, waged an extended campaign against Allied shipping. The Royal Navy countered with motor torpedo boat flotillas and escort groups defending convoy routes and attacking Axis coastal traffic. The US Navy deployed PT boat flotillas in the Pacific, where they disrupted Japanese barge traffic, scouted invasion beaches, and ambushed supply convoys in island chains like the Solomons and Philippines. On inland waters, US river flotillas supported amphibious operations in Burma and China with shallow-draft gunboats and landing craft. Soviet flotillas along the Volga and Danube supported ground offensives, while Italian MAS boats and Japanese fast attack units challenged Allied control of narrow seas. Despite their small size, flotillas played decisive roles in local battles, often shaping broader strategic outcomes.

intro_zh_hans: 铁路运输是二战时期军事后勤的中坚力量。
intro_en: Rail transport was the backbone of military logistics in WWII.
history_zh_hans: 二战期间，铁路运输对军事后勤至关重要。各个主要参战国都曾使用补给列车，在广阔地域间转运部队、武器、燃料、食物和弹药。德军的闪电战战术依靠铁路来供给快速推进的部队。苏联则利用铁路网跨越数千公里调动军队和工厂。在美国，庞大的铁路系统将人员与物资从训练基地运送至港口，以便部署海外。火车为前线部队输送关键物资，也因此频繁成为轰炸与袭击的目标。地形、天气以及敌军行动常使运输受阻，军队会为此铺设临时轨道、施加伪装，并部署流动维修队。铁路枢纽成为关键战略要地，一些补给线每天能运送数千吨物资。在许多战役中，能否保持铁路畅通是决定胜负的关键因素。
history_en: Rail transport was essential to military logistics in WWII. All major powers used supply trains to move troops, weapons, fuel, food, and ammunition across vast distances. Germany’s blitzkrieg tactics relied on rail to sustain fast-moving forces. The Soviet Union used its network to shift armies and entire factories across thousands of kilometers. In the US, a vast rail system transported men and materiel from training bases to ports for overseas deployment. Trains delivered vital supplies to front-line units and were frequent targets for bombing and sabotage. Terrain, weather, and enemy action often disrupted operations, so armies built temporary tracks, used camouflage, and deployed mobile repair crews. Rail hubs became critical points of strategy, and some supply lines moved thousands of tons daily. In many campaigns, success depended on keeping the trains running.

intro_zh_hans: 地堡是一种经过加固的防御工事，能抵御猛烈火力的攻击。
intro_en: A bunker is a reinforced structure used for protection against heavy fire.
history_zh_hans: 地堡是一种经过加固的掩蔽工事，用于保护士兵和装备免受炮火与炸弹袭击。这种工事多建于地下或半埋于土中。二战期间，地堡种类繁多，小到混凝土堑壕掩体，大到墙体厚达数米的海岸炮阵地。其钢筋混凝土结构与厚重的覆土层能有效削弱爆炸冲击波，承受猛烈轰炸。坚固的防护门与完善的通风系统也对长期坚守至关重要。
history_en: A bunker is a fortified shelter built to protect soldiers and equipment from artillery and bombs. Most are underground or partly dug into the earth. In WWII, bunkers ranged from small concrete trench shelters to massive coastal gun positions with walls several meters thick. Reinforced concrete and heavy earth cover helped deflect blast waves and survive intense bombardment. Strong doors and ventilation were essential for prolonged defense.
photo_caption_zh_hans: 大西洋壁垒上的一座德军地堡，法国，1944 年盟军登陆前夕。

intro_zh_hans: 二战期间，达尔文要塞是盟军的重要前哨。
intro_en: Darwin Fort is a military fortification in Darwin, Australia, during World War II.
history_zh_hans: 到 1942 年，达尔文已从一个北部小镇转变为一个拥挤的盟军基地。战前，达尔文人口仅约 5,800 人，但其港口、机场、道路和燃料储备使其成为向帝汶岛、爪哇岛和菲律宾推进的关键枢纽。防御工事逐步在半岛周边展开。东岬角以 6 英寸海岸炮封锁海上航道，防空阵地则覆盖范妮湾、东臂及各个机场。一道长达 6 公里的防潜网横跨达尔文港，用于阻挡潜艇及小型水面舰艇。然而，这座要塞在 1942 年日军来袭时仍未完工。达尔文拥有 18 门重型防空炮，战斗机力量有限，且没有可用的雷达预警系统。2 月 19 日，航母舰载机与陆基轰炸机对港口、城镇与机场发动空袭。MV 海王星号货轮在斯托克斯山码头爆炸，USS 皮尔里号驱逐舰被击沉，RAAF 达尔文基地也遭到严重破坏。空袭暴露出达尔文防御体系的脆弱，也迫使盟军在澳大利亚北部展开更大规模的空中力量部署。
history_en: By 1942, Darwin had changed from a small northern town into a crowded Allied base. Its pre-war population was only about 5,800, but its harbour, airfields, roads, and fuel stores made it vital for operations toward Timor, Java, and the Philippines. The defence works grew around the peninsula. East Point guarded the sea approaches with 6-inch coastal guns, while anti-aircraft positions covered Fannie Bay, East Arm, and the airfields. A 6 km boom net stretched across Darwin Harbour to block submarines and small surface craft. The fortress was still unfinished when Japan struck in 1942. Darwin had 18 heavy anti-aircraft guns, limited fighter strength, and no working radar warning system. On 19 February, carrier-based aircraft and land-based bombers hit the harbour, town, and airfields. MV Neptuna exploded at Stokes Hill Wharf, USS Peary was sunk, and RAAF Darwin was badly damaged. The raids exposed Darwin’s weakness, but they also forced a larger Allied air build-up across northern Australia.
